text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The way that girl Fine Motion runs... 
it's, like, really amazing.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
They look like they're having so much 
fun... Must be nice.

Fine Motion delivered brilliant results. I 
expected her to return in her usual state 
of high excitement, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It was soooooooo much fuuuuuuuun♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Classic races are truly incredible, 
aren't they...!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The intensity of the girls running 
alongside me was incredible! Even I felt 
the electrifying thrill!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: To think races like this will continue—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's wrong? You've completely 
frozen up.
choice_data_list: The reason you looked in pain was...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ehe, looks like I got a bit too excited!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Condition is in tip-top shape, A-plus♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Was that confusing? I just... got so 
happy, you see...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I've learned my lesson. I won't do 
anything to make you worry anymore!"
choice_data_list: Feel free to act however you like.

text_block_list.text:
"I might still worry too much in the 
future. Even so, I wanted her to forget 
her worries, give it her all, and simply 
enjoy what was right in front of her."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Now you've said it~

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean I can have all-you-can-eat 
ramen before training?

I meant for them to forget about their 
status and surroundings, and be truly free 
in front of me, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I know. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then run to your heart's content! —Let's 
head toward the next race, the Yushun 
Himba (Oaks)!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're not allowed to call me 
that! It definitely has to be Fine. Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —*sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice... Looks like fun, I'm so 
jealous...

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Because Fine-chan is... "Your 
Highness," after all.
